entities.name: Jacob Hauken
entities.description: A geistmage and investigator hired by Lord Nellick, raised among the Vizag Atum geist-worshippers, who has left them and takes on geist-related cases.

entities.name: Eloise Wicker
entities.description: A young detective in Selhoff who brought Jacob in on the case and is possessed by Cyril Rav, then hunts for him.

entities.name: Cyril Rav
entities.description: A necro-alchemist geist who possesses the bodies of influential people and set off the failed geistbomb; he hires Jacob and offers him a partnership.

entities.name: Lord Nellick
entities.description: A wealthy businessman of Selhoff whose body is taken by Rav and who is later found dead in his parlor.

entities.name: Millicent
entities.description: A geist who was once a resident of a riverside community destroyed by Rav's geistbomb, now hunting him across Nephalia.

entities.name: The physician
entities.description: A woman physician whose body Rav briefly possesses to spy on Jacob.

entities.name: Vizag Atum
entities.description: The group of geist-talkers that raised Jacob and revered geists as sources of true wisdom.

entities.name: Keepers of the Pale
entities.description: Church hunters of geists whom Jacob leaves to hunting.

entities.name: Jacob's friend
entities.description: Jacob's childhood friend, found strangled, whose death led him to investigate geist-related incidents.

entities.name: Selhoff
entities.description: A city on the edge of the world on the Bay of Vustrow, where the story is set.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: The region of Innistrad ravaged by a horde of geists.

entities.name: Havengul
entities.description: A city whose mayor was pushed off a roof by Rav's possessed geist attacks.

entities.name: Alrun River
entities.description: A river along which the inhospitable villages lie.

entities.name: Bay of Vustrow
entities.description: The dark, cold bay beyond the docks of Selhoff.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane, plunged into permanent night.

entities.name: The Travails
entities.description: The catastrophe after which magic became harder and the Plane fell apart.

entities.name: Geistbomb
entities.description: An explosive device fueled with dead souls that misfired and killed a village.

entities.name: Blood seal
entities.description: A paper seal painted in Jacob's blood that lets Millicent be heard and anchors her to her memories.

events.summary: Jacob Hauken meets Lord Nellick and Detective Wicker in Selhoff to discuss a horde of geists killing the morally bankrupt across Nephalia.
events.quote: "Thank you for your punctuality, Mr. Hauken."

events.summary: Wicker questions Nellick about why geists would target him, and Jacob advises him to stay inside and get wards.
events.quote: "Stay inside, Lord Nellick, though I'm sure I don't have to tell you that nowadays.

events.summary: Wicker shakes Nellick's hand, goes still, and then hurriedly leads Jacob away, telling him to call her Eloise.
events.quote: "You can call me Eloise," she says

events.summary: Eloise tells Jacob about a vacant tower and a necro-alchemist's misfired geistbomb.
events.quote: A geistbomb misfired. Killed a bunch of people.

events.summary: A swarm of geists forms into a screaming woman who throws Eloise against a wall until Jacob banishes her.
events.quote: The gale slams into Eloise, knocking her backward against the alley wall.

events.summary: In an inn, a strangely hypnotic Eloise draws out Jacob's backstory and suggests he jump into the bay.
Eloise touches Jacob's face and thanks him for his story, and he feels something oily try to slide beneath his skin.
events.quote: She touches cold fingertips to his face.

events.summary: A physician examines Eloise and speaks oddly to Jacob; later Eloise says she remembers nothing after the merchant's cold hands.
events.quote: "I remember . . . the merchant in the tower.

events.summary: The geist returns, and Jacob uses his own blood to draw a seal that lets her speak; she names herself Millicent and says a man used her community's spirits.
Millicent's account and Eloise's lack of memory lead Jacob to realize that the necro-alchemist is possessing people.
events.quote: Once again, she looks at Eloise. And Jacob understands.

events.summary: Jacob visits Nellick, asks about Cyril Rav, feels possession begin and pushes the necro-alchemist out.
events.quote: "Have you ever possessed a geistmage before? I promise you won't like it."

events.summary: Rav, in Nellick's body, admits he hired Jacob, that the geistbomb misfired and that the mayor was a stolen body he discarded.
events.quote: "Of course. I would much rather my geistbomb succeed than fail.

events.summary: Rav offers Jacob a partnership, promising protection or help finding his friend's killers.
events.quote: "I think we should go into business together."

events.summary: Jacob, worn down, admits he is just tired, and Rav says he knows; the page leaves his answer open.
events.quote: Jacob closes his eyes. "I'm just tired."

events.summary: Eloise and Millicent go to Nellick's mansion and find two unconscious servants and Nellick's body but no Jacob.
events.quote: She finds two unconscious servants in the kitchen, and a body in the parlor: Lord Nellick.

events.summary: Eloise offers to work for Millicent and tells her to keep the seal.
events.quote: "I've never worked for a geist before, but my rates are very reasonable."

relations.note: Rav possessed and wore Nellick's body.
relations.quote: "This is rather awkward for me, I admit," Rav says
"Bad luck, then. You shouldn't have possessed my colleague."

relations.note: She has been bent on revenge against him.
relations.quote: she's been bent on revenge since that whole unfortunate affair

relations.note: He was raised among them and left.
relations.quote: "I left that group a long time ago."

relations.note: They worked together on the investigation.
relations.quote: They worked briefly together three years ago

relations.note: Eloise offers to work for her.
relations.quote: You just need someone to fight for you.
I would much rather my geistbomb succeed than fail.

relations.note: Selhoff is on the edge of the world.
relations.quote: Selhoff is a city on the edge of the world
